Single Oly oysters and Oly oysters attached to Pacific shell
So many of this one species of dorid, likely Onchidoris bilamellata (https://www.inaturalist.org/guide_taxa/1588641), could be leather limpet, and also many mossy chitons on this Pacific shell
So many juvenile limpets (maybe the shield limpet Lottia pelta)

There was a piece of wood in this quadrat covered in Olys. There were juvenile Olys settled on adult Olys in this quadrat. Datasheet says 8 Olys but there are 9 shell height measurements, so the number was corrected to 9 Olys.

Many mussels. In seep. Species present at this site include: Onchidella borealis (leather limpet), Ulva, Mytillus, Crescent Gunnel, Platyhelminthes, Polychaete worms, Tube worms, small unID snail (Amphisa?), Alia spp.
